reportable_as_visibility_result: A defined public-record test has begun.
not_equivalent_to: Agency possession, disclosure, or substantive support.
next_action: Wait for acknowledgement; preserve tracking number.

minimum_evidence_to_code: case number/receipt number or written acknowledgement
reportable_as_visibility_result: The request entered this agency's process.
next_action: Record stated custodian and due/extension date.

minimum_evidence_to_code: written estimate or consultation note tied to request
meaning: Agency seeks fee commitment, clarification or narrowing.
reportable_as_visibility_result: Current scope exceeds routine processing or needs clarification.
not_equivalent_to: Denial, refusal, or absence of records.
next_action: Preserve original scope, estimate and negotiated revision; record change note.

meaning: Named agency says another unit may control all or part of the records.
reportable_as_visibility_result: The declared custodian did not fully control the requested record family.
next_action: Open a new request only after recording destination and retained scope.

minimum_evidence_to_code: formal written no-record/not-held determination with custodian/period/scope
meaning: Agency did not locate responsive held records after processing the stated request.
reportable_as_visibility_result: At this agency, period and described record layer, no responsive held record was located.
not_equivalent_to: Underlying transaction, service, allocation or document elsewhere does not exist.
next_action: Check adequacy/custody wording; consider appeal or retarget only by new decision.

minimum_evidence_to_code: released file plus redaction/partial-disclosure notice and cited basis
meaning: Some responsive material released and some withheld/redacted.
reportable_as_visibility_result: This record layer is partly visible under stated exemptions/grounds.
not_equivalent_to: Hidden portion proves a specific fact or motive.
next_action: Code released fields separately; retain grounds/page scope; consider segregability/appeal decision.

minimum_evidence_to_code: formal denial/non-disclosure decision with statutory exemption/ground
meaning: Agency withheld responsive record(s) or declined disclosure under cited rule.
reportable_as_visibility_result: This record layer is unavailable through this request route under stated grounds.
not_equivalent_to: No record exists; the content proves wrongdoing or secrecy motive.
next_action: Preserve decision; consider administrative appeal only after principal decision.

minimum_evidence_to_code: written closure due to fee/nonresponse/insufficient description/other procedural cause
meaning: Request ended without a substantive custodian search or release.
reportable_as_visibility_result: The selected request did not produce a completed visibility test.
next_action: Reopen only with documented revised scope/fee decision.

not_equivalent_to: Refusal, release, or lack of records.
next_action: Update ledger and wait; do not use in findings.
